title: A tight lower bound on input-side role information for exact multi-hop retrieval
premises: P1 (task). An instance consists of n binding pairs, each pair being two tokens carrying symbols (u_p, w_p) from a shared alphabet Sigma of size V_K. A role assignment rho in {0,1}^(2n) decides, for each pair, which token is the KEY and which is the VALUE; together with the pair positions this defines a DIRECTED binding graph G. Pair order is arbitrary, an arbitrary number of zero FILLER tokens may appear between pairs, and symbols may repeat. The answer is k_H(G), the endpoint of the H-hop chain starting from an externally supplied query q = k_0. P2 (visible input). The model sees Vis = (x_1..x_L, s_1..s_L, q), where x_t is the SYMBOL ID ONLY (flat alphabet: keys and values share ids) and s_t in {0,1}^{b_t} is an optional side-channel; B = sum_t b_t is its total information in bits. The role assignment rho is NOT in x. The input embedding e: Sigma -> R^V is fixed and independent of t and of other tokens. P3 (model class of interest, M). H_L layers; each layer applies a STATIC LTI kernel K_h(d) = sum_p w_hp rho_hp^d (time-invariant, content-independent coefficients); fixed-dimensional state independent of L; fixed linear layer interfaces; last-layer read-out only; deterministic. NOTE: parts (a),(b) below hold for ANY deterministic model and need NONE of P3. P4 (no stop/select). Only the last layer's output is decoded; intermediate outputs are not retained. P5 (uniform instance distribution). For the accuracy statement, instances sharing the same Vis are equiprobable.
claim: (a) UNIVERSAL IMPOSSIBILITY. For any deterministic model (no LTI, depth, state or read-out assumption), if |A(x,q,H)| >= 2 then the model cannot be correct on all instances compatible with Vis; accuracy <= 1/|A| <= 1/2. (b) BIT LOWER BOUND. Exact retrieval on all compatible instances requires B >= log2 |A(x,q,H)| bits. There is an explicit family with |A| = 2^m for every m <= n, hence B >= m bits; taking m = n gives B >= n. If the pairing itself is also not encoded in x (fully non-adjacent binding), |A| >= n! and B >= log2(n!) = Theta(n log n). The bound is a property of the TASK, independent of H_L, state order P, kernel parameters (rho, theta, w), and the number of layers. (c) THE CLASS M CANNOT MANUFACTURE THESE BITS. Within P3, increasing H_L, P, or changing (rho, theta, w) cannot lower the bound. The only content dependence of the computation enters through e(x_t) and the absolute position t; under arbitrary filler spacing the pair positions are independent of rho, and e is fixed, so the output is invariant under changes of rho that leave Vis fixed. To make the kernel itself carry role information one must make its coefficients input-dependent and hence time-varying; by T4 (Toeplitz IFF parameter-time-invariant for the second-order recurrence with c_t != 0), that destroys the Toeplitz structure and the single-FFT / IIR duality. Therefore: TO KEEP DUALITY, THE MISSING BITS MUST BE SUPPLIED ON THE INPUT SIDE. (d) TIGHTNESS AND CONSERVATION. The bound is attained by three information-equivalent carriers, each supplying exactly 1 bit per ambiguous token: (i) an explicit 1-bit KEY/VALUE tag; (ii) an alphabet partition V -> 2V (Corollary R2), which is precisely log2(2) = 1 bit per token folded into the id and PRESERVES Toeplitz, O(1) state and zero-training exactness; (iii) an absolute-position format prior (the withdrawn W9), which encodes the same bit in an ASSUMPTION ABOUT THE INPUT DISTRIBUTION rather than in the data. When arbitrary filler spacing is allowed the assumption in (iii) ceases to hold, its effective information drops to zero, and accuracy collapses quantitatively (1.0000 -> 0.3438 +/- 0.0314). Information does not disappear; it only changes carrier, and no carrier can beat (b). (e) THE BIT-DEPTH FRONTIER IS A RIGHT ANGLE. For every B >= log2|A| the minimum required depth is still exactly H (Theorem 2); for every B < log2|A| NO depth suffices. There is NO smooth rate at which extra layers buy fewer input bits. Consequently 'b bits <-> minimum layers' is a step function, not a trade-off curve. (f) OVERSHOOT IS NOT AN ARCHITECTURAL LAW. The failure at H_L > H is a consequence of P4 (last-layer read-out, no stop/select). Retaining intermediate outputs and selecting the H-th makes H_L >= H sufficient; the LOWER bound H is unchanged. Necessity of exactly H layers must not be read as a law of the architecture.
proof: Proof (a). The output y = F(Vis) is a single deterministic value. Two instances G, G' in R(x) with the same Vis require two distinct answers k_H(G) != k_H(G'). F(Vis) can equal at most one of them. Under P5 the fraction correct is at most 1/|A| <= 1/2. No property of F beyond determinism is used; in particular no assumption about kernels, state order, depth or read-out. QED. Proof (b). The side-channel is a function S: R(x) -> {0,1}^B. F may depend on S, so instances can be distinguished only if S is injective on the answer classes of R(x): whenever k_H(G) != k_H(G') we need S(G) != S(G'), otherwise (a) applies to the pair. A map into {0,1}^B has at most 2^B fibres, so 2^B >= |A|, i.e. B >= log2|A|. EXPLICIT FAMILY WITH |A| = 2^m (binary-chain construction). Fix m <= n and take H = m hops. At hop h the visible sequence contains one key symbol k_h and TWO candidate value symbols p_h, q_h; a bit d_h in {0,1} that is NOT recorded in x selects which candidate is the valid binding, and the selected value is the key of hop h+1. The two candidates are both present as tokens, so every vector d = (d_1..d_m) yields the SAME visible symbol sequence x and the same query q = k_1. Map d to the endpoint id sum_h d_h 2^(h-1); with V >= 2^m these are 2^m DISTINCT endpoints, hence |A(x,q,H)| = 2^m and B >= m. The witness enumerates all 2^m assignments and confirms bit-identical visible inputs (max deviation 0.0). Choosing m = n gives B >= n. FULLY NON-ADJACENT CASE. If even the pairing is not recoverable from x, R(x) contains all n! matchings between n key slots and n value slots; by the same injectivity argument B >= log2(n!). Because the main theorem already holds in the STRICTER (more model-friendly) setting where pairing IS recoverable from x, it holds a fortiori when it is not. QED. Proof (c). In M, layer h computes z_h = sum_t K_h(L-1-t) m_h[t] b_t with m_h[t] = <q_h, e(x_(t-1))> and b_t = e(x_t), and q_(h+1) = T_h(z_h) with T_h fixed linear. K_h depends only on the lag d and on fixed parameters, never on x; T_h is fixed; e is fixed. Therefore the entire composition is a function of the multiset of (symbol id, position) pairs plus q, i.e. of Vis with s removed. Under arbitrary filler spacing the positions of the pair tokens are determined by filler counts that are independent of rho, so the mapping rho -> (symbol, position) data is constant on R(x). Hence F is constant on R(x): no choice of H_L, P or (rho,theta,w) changes this, and (a) applies with full force. Now suppose one tries to encode rho in the KERNEL instead. Then the recurrence coefficients become functions of x_t and, since x varies with t, they become time-varying. For y_t = a_t y_(t-1) + b_t y_(t-2) + c_t u_t with c_t != 0, T4 proves the impulse response is Toeplitz IFF (a,b,c) are constant in t; time-varying coefficients give a non-Toeplitz h(t,s), no single H(z), and the single-FFT path fails (we negate THAT path, not every conceivable O(L log L) algorithm). So within the architecture family that keeps duality, the bits can only enter on the input side. QED. Proof (d). TIGHTNESS. Carrier (i): set s_t = 1 bit equal to the KEY/VALUE role; then S(rho) = rho is injective on answer classes and B = 2n >= n, so (b) is attained (up to the constant factor 2 from tagging both tokens of each pair; tagging only the key token gives B = n exactly, which is tight). Carrier (ii): R2 gives an exact construction with no run-time tag by using two orthogonal halves of the codebook; the id of each token now carries log2(2V_K / V_K) = 1 bit, and 1.0000 accuracy is attained on all four layouts with zero training, Toeplitz deviation 0.0 and FFT/IIR error 2.89e-16. So the bit is present, just folded into the alphabet. CONSERVATION. All three carriers supply the same 1 bit per ambiguous token: (i) as explicit data, (ii) as alphabet capacity, (iii) as a distributional assumption. Carrier (iii) is free ONLY while the assumption holds. The W9 experiment breaks exactly that assumption (random zero fillers make key parity independent of the answer); the effective supplied information falls to 0, the bound (b) is violated, and accuracy falls to 0.3438 +/- 0.0314 (5 seeds), consistent with (a)'s <= 1/2 prediction rather than with chance 1/V_K. QED. Proof (e). By (b), B < log2|A| makes exactness impossible for EVERY deterministic model, hence for every H_L; increasing depth cannot help. By Theorem 2 (NT31/R2), when B >= log2|A| the minimum depth is exactly H, with H_L < H at chance and H_L > H overshooting under P4. The frontier in (B, minimum H_L) is therefore {(B < log2|A|): infeasible} union {(B >= log2|A|): H_L = H}, a right angle. QED. Proof (f). Under P4 the decoded value at depth H_L is k_(H_L). For H_L > H this differs from k_H because chain keys are distinct. If instead the H-th intermediate output is retained and selected, the answer is k_H for any H_L >= H; the lower bound H_L >= H is unchanged (a single layer still cannot perform two content matches). Hence 'exactly H' is a statement about the read-out convention, not an architectural law. QED. NON-VACUITY. n = 4, m = 2, V_K = 32, H = 2, H_L = 2, flat alphabet, arbitrary filler spacing: B = 0 gives |A| = 4 and accuracy <= 1/4; B = 2 (tag only the two key tokens) gives 1.0000; the empirical witnesses in results/info_bound_*.json trace the step at B = m.
boundary: SCOPE. (i) Parts (a),(b) are UNIVERSAL and make NO architectural assumption; we deliberately do NOT claim they are new information theory. The novelty is (c),(d),(e): the FORCED LOCATION of the bits under Toeplitz duality, three-way conservation with a tight duality-preserving construction, and the right-angle frontier. (ii) 'Exact' means correct on EVERY compatible instance, not high average accuracy; a probabilistic or majority decoder is outside P5. (iii) The bit bound is on INPUT-SIDE information. It does NOT say a model cannot learn a role predictor from a training distribution; it says that when the visible input genuinely lacks the information, no deterministic decoder can recover it. A learned prior that guesses rho from x is exactly carrier (iii) and inherits its fragility. (iv) Constant factors: tagging both tokens of a pair costs 2n bits while the tight value is n; we state the tight version. (v) The |A| = 2^m family requires V_K >= 2^m; for arbitrary V_K take m <= floor(log2 V_K) or use R = 2^ceil(log2 V_K) Hadamard rows. (vi) (c) negates the single-FFT convolution path, not every possible O(L log L) algorithm, and is proved for the second-order recurrence with c_t != 0 (T4's scope). (vii) The theorem is about SYNTHETIC content-chain retrieval. It makes no claim about language modeling, perplexity, generation, throughput, or superiority over any baseline. (viii) RELATION TO LEMMA R3. An earlier lemma in this line of work states that 'exactly one role bit is necessary'. That statement is about a PER-TOKEN symbol-role distinction and is the WORST-CASE instance |A| = 2 of Theorem A: R3 exhibits one legal dataset on which zero bits force every model in the class to output the distractor (accuracy 0), whereas (a) gives the weaker uniform-average bound 1/|A| = 1/2. Theorem A does NOT overturn R3; it REFINES it in two ways: the necessary quantity is the TOTAL input-side information B >= log2|A| (not 'exactly one bit'), and |A| can be 2^m for any m <= n, so the requirement grows with the number of distinct compatible answers. Consequently 'one bit per token' is a SUFFICIENT carrier, not a necessary one, and an explicit role tag is neither necessary nor the information-theoretically minimal carrier. (ix) 'Side-channel' includes any deterministic function of the instance that the model can observe; folding it into token ids, positions or an explicit tag are all counted in B.
novelty: Zoology (2312.04927), Repeat After Me (2402.01032) and Illusion of State (2404.08819) establish that fixed-state models are weak at associative recall; S5 (2208.04933) and Mamba (2312.00752) establish that LTI requires time-invariant coefficients and that selectivity breaks the convolution view. None of these quantifies a BIT lower bound on input-side role information, none proves that the bits are FORCED to the input side by Toeplitz duality, and none identifies the right-angle bit-depth frontier. Our increment is the exact quantification plus the location theorem plus conservation; we do NOT claim to be the first to observe that input format can carry task-relevant information. Our own earlier one-bit lemma (R3) is the |A|=2 worst-case special case; Theorem A generalizes it to a quantitative total-bit bound and removes the 'exactly one bit' wording, which was an over-statement of necessity.
use: Converts the three killer objections into answers stated IN THE MAIN TEXT, before rebuttal. 'The format solves the task' -> yes, and Theorem A says exactly how many bits it must supply and proves the format cannot be beaten. 'Isn't this linear attention with extra steps' -> (c) shows that keeping Toeplitz (which linear attention with rho=1 also does) forces the bits to the input; the separation is about WHERE the information lives, not about the state update. 'Toy synthetic, zero training' -> (b),(e) are distribution-free and depth-free, so they are not toy facts that more layers would fix. Engineering rule: budget at least log2|A| bits on the input side, or relax exactness; extra layers cannot substitute.
source: Analytic proof above. Empirical witnesses (NOT the proof): results/info_bound_scan.json, info_bound_depth.json, info_bound_carriers.json, info_bound_adjudication.json.
